jei.entropica.info.diluted_essence:
Diluted Essence Fluid is capable of transforming matter.

To create it, simply toss raw Essence items directly into a pool of Water.

Once the water transforms into Diluted Essence Fluid, you can toss specific items into the fluid to trigger transformations.
jei.entropica.info.amber_chunk:
Amber Chunks are harvested by stripping the bark off Amber Logs or Amber Wood using an Axe.

Used in alchemical distils, wand foci, arcana book binding, and crystal alchemy.
jei.entropica.info.dynamic_weapon_crafti:
To forge a Dynamic Weapon, you must place a Shape Concept, a Core, an Orbis Acceptor, and 4 Base Material Ingots in the center of the Eidolic Lathe.

Optionally, surround it with up to 16 modifiers (like Spell Gems or Quartz) on Attunement Pedestals.

Pipe between 500 and 100,000 Materia Fumus into the Lathe to begin forging!
